description: BLOCK 243000 -- LANGSIM: the BUILD/PRODUCTION affordance as a graph RULE for the economy+building language-limitation probe. An agent holding BOTH input resources (has_x==1 AND has_y==1) BUILDS a structure of value: the rule ls_build sets built=1 on the agent's BuildState. This is the agent DECISION that makes trade valuable -- you must acquire the resource you lack (via a real promise utterance the partner comprehends) before you can build. Integer-native (Eq/And/Attr only; no Rust, no new Term). OFF by default: self_load_only, nothing depends_on it, the rule guards on BuildState.enabled -- absent it every existing path is byte-identical. The give/keep trade decision is REUSED verbatim from glassbox_r1_social (gb_choose_give); this seed adds only the build decision.

microtheory.name: langsim_build
microtheory.description: Building is the production affordance that rewards trade: an agent gathers one input each tick but needs the complementary input (acquired by trade, mediated by a comprehended promise utterance) to build. Whether an agent builds is not scripted -- it is the ls_build rule firing once its held inputs are both present.

rules.name: ls_build
rules.comment: THE BUILD DECISION: an agent whose BuildState holds both inputs (has_x==1 AND has_y==1) and is not already built sets built=1. Building consumes nothing here (the world adapter realises the value + resets holdings mechanically on the emit side); the rule DECIDES that a build is admissible now. Guarded on enabled so the seed is inert unless a BuildState carries enabled=1.
